about_the_game:
Roguelikes are designed to be addicting, play with moderation. 

50% of profits from game sales will be donated to organizations that help treat/prevent problem gambling.

You shouldn't gamble unless you are expecting to lose your money.

Scorefall is a calm roguelite based on pachinko where you drop balls into a chaotic field of pegs, chase high scores, and build powerful upgrade combos as you progress through 50 increasingly challenging rounds. Deep progression systems, strategic choices, and a relaxed lo-fi aesthetic. Chill out and drop some balls.

Drop. Bounce. Score.

Each ball you drop has a multiplier. Each bucket has a point value. When a ball lands in a bucket, its multiplier is applied to that bucket's score. Hit your target score each round to advance.

Choose Upgrades After Every Round

After completing a round, you’ll choose one of three upgrades that modify your balls, pegs, or buckets. Each upgrade has a rarity that affects its power.

Visit the Relic Shop

After every five rounds, you’ll enter the Relic Shop where you can purchase powerful relics using coins collected during your run. Relics provide global effects that can dramatically shift your strategy.

Meta Progression

Every ball you use during a run contributes to your Meta Ball total. These Meta Balls can be spent to unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs easier and more customizable. Increase your chances of finding rare upgrades, reduce your drop randomness, unlock Rerolls, Free Drops and more.
